name: Section
intent: A titled block of a page, like Account information or Recent invoices: a header with a line under it, optional help and buttons, and the content below. It can collapse.
usage: Use Section to split a page under its PageHeader into titled parts, each holding a Table, FormDisplay rows, a Scoreboard or a Form. It is one component: pass title and the content as children, or leave children out for a header only, like a heading above content laid out by the page. Page edge padding and gap between Section blocks come from layout classes (`.layout-content`), not from Section — see contracts/layout.json. help adds a ? icon after the title that opens a HelpPopover. actions holds kit Buttons at the end of the header. collapsible adds a chevron button before the title that hides and shows the content; it starts open unless defaultOpen is false. A Section inside another Section's children is a sub-block: its title steps down to text-heading-xs on its own, so the outer title stays the louder one. Its stacked blocks sit one grid gutter apart. See contracts/section.json for the full contract.

description.note: One short line under the title.

help.note: Adds a ? icon after the title that opens a HelpPopover titled with the section title, like the field help icons.

actions.note: Kit Buttons or a DropdownMenu at the end of the header, usually size sm. One primary Button per view.

children.note: The section's content. Leave it out for a header only: the title row and its line, with nothing below.

collapsible.note: A chevron button before the title hides and shows the content.

defaultOpen.note: Starting open state when collapsible and not controlled.

useWhen: Splitting a record or dashboard page into titled parts, like Account information, Contacts and Invoices.
Long detail pages where people fold away parts they don't need: make them collapsible.
Stacking titled blocks inside `.layout-content` so the page owns edge padding and between-section gap.
doNot: Do not invent a SectionHeader, SectionTitle or a heading with a border. Use Section.
Do not use it for the page title. Use PageHeader.
Do not use it for a list of questions that open one at a time. Use Accordion.
Do not put a Section around a Form's own sections. Form has sections.
Do not add outer padding, margin, or gap on Section for page inset or between-section rhythm. The page uses `.layout-content` (or equivalent layout class); read contracts/layout.json.
Do not invent a padded Section cousin or wrapper for spacing. Use layout classes.
a11y: A section element named by its h2 title.
The chevron is a kit Button named by the title, with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the content. Collapsed content is hidden, so it is skipped by keyboard and screen readers.
The help icon is a button named About plus the title; the help text is also the heading's description.
snippet:
<Section
  title="Account information"
  help="Details from the account record. Edit them on the account."
  collapsible
  actions={<Button size="sm" iconStart="edit">Edit</Button>}
>
  <FormDisplay label="Account name" value="Northwind Traders" />
</Section>
